about: High school girls + Japanese swords! Enter the arena, take on a swarm of enemies and leave none standing in this action-fuelled indie game.The player can use their sword, melee attacks and powered attacks to drive back their enemies.
Collect skill points to upgrade your techniques and confront even greater foes.
Feel a surge of pleasure as you make use of both swift attacks and destructive techniques to scatter your enemies!
Additional hardware required for Remote Play.
